name: mods
description: Claude Code interface mods by kadragon. Claude Code only; built on the early-access function-hooks API.

statusBandEnabled.title: Status band
statusBandEnabled.description: Show the model, effort, directory, git branch, session time, prompt-cache time left, hook, skill and MCP server counts, context fill, rate limits, a due harness-curate run, and — in a harness repo — the task cycle on the branch (contract, evidence, PR and CI, with a toast when CI settles) and the backlog queue depth above the prompt.

statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.title: Status band cache TTL (minutes)
statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is taken to live after a response, for the status band's countdown: 60, or 5 where the session runs on the short cache.

statusBandAscii.title: Status band in plain ASCII
statusBandAscii.description: Draw the status band's separators, effort mark, context bar and cut branch names in ASCII, for a terminal that leaves stale cells or broken glyphs behind on redraw (Wave on Windows).
